accent.$description: Highlight color for active or focused elements

accent-foreground.$description: Text and icons on accent-colored elements

destructive-foreground.$description: Text and icons on destructive-colored elements

foreground.$description: Primary text color on the background

muted.$description: Subdued background for less important elements

popover.$description: Background for dropdown menus and popovers

primary.$description: Brand color for primary actions (buttons, highlights)

primary-weak.$description: Brand color for primary actions (buttons, highlights)

primary-extraweak.$description: Brand color for primary actions (buttons, highlights)

primary-foreground.$description: Text and icons on primary-colored elements

secondary-foreground.$description: Text and icons on secondary-colored elements

ring-offset.$description: The color of the space between a focused element and its ring outline

background-dark-calendar-30.$description: Used in UI elements that have background color variable in light mode and input/30 variable in dark mode

accent-dark-input-50.$description: Used in UI elements that have accent color variable in light mode and input/50 variable in dark mode

accent-dark-calendar-50.$description: Used in UI elements that have accent color variable in light mode and input/50 variable in dark mode

input-dark-input-80.$description: Used in UI elements that have input color variable in light mode and input/80 variable in dark mode

destructive-dark-destructive-60.$description: Used in UI elements that have destructive color variable in light mode and destructive/60 variable in dark mode

destructive-dark-destructive-70.$description: Used in UI elements that have destructive color variable in light mode and destructive/70 variable in dark mode

destructive-dark-destructive-90.$description: Used in UI elements that have destructive color variable in light mode and destructive/90 variable in dark mode

destructive-20-dark-destructive-40.$description: Used in UI elements that have destructive/20 color variable in light mode and destructive/40 variable in dark mode

destructive-40-dark-destructive-60.$description: Used in UI elements that have destructive/40 color variable in light mode and destructive/60 variable in dark mode
